name: loopback
description: Connects Claude Code to your Loopback inbox and routes every question the agent has for you there, with no prompting: the session is told to ask through Loopback, Claude Code's built-in question prompt is redirected there, and a turn that ends with a question in the conversation is sent back to ask it through Loopback.

url.title: Loopback URL
url.description: Where your Loopback is deployed, such as https://loopback.example.workers.dev

token.title: Loopback token
token.description: The LOOPBACK_TOKEN your deployment was set up with
